_comment: The shot manifest — one source of truth, read by tools/baseline.gd and by
tools/harness.py. Vantage points are deliberately fixed forever: a review
pass is only comparable to the previous one if the camera has not moved.
kind:  world  free camera over scenes/world/bridge_arena.tscn, no actors.
game   a real match from scenes/main.tscn, the game's own camera.
menu   scenes/main.tscn left in MENU state.
settle: engine frames pumped before the shutter. Under --fixed-fps this is
an exact simulation duration, so temporal effects (sky radiance,
SSAO/SSIL accumulation, auto-exposure, tweens) converge from the same
phase on every run and on every machine.
script: [action, frames] beats fed as synthetic input before settling.

shots.name: 01_deck_mid
shots.intent: The playable corridor. The single most-looked-at surface in the game.

shots.name: 02_deck_eye
shots.intent: Eye level down the deck toward Porto — the game's signature view.

shots.name: 03_rail_macro
shots.intent: Material bar: granite and wrought iron at half a metre. Detail layer must still be working here.

shots.name: 04_cobble_macro
shots.intent: Material bar: the deck surface at grazing angle. Where flat texturing is impossible to hide.

shots.name: 05_arch_under
shots.intent: The structure from below. Tests the soffit and the truss — the parts a fill light has to reach.

shots.name: 06_river_wide
shots.intent: The whole bridge in context. Silhouette and aerial perspective.

shots.name: 07_ribeira
shots.intent: The Porto facades. The 'is this recognisably Porto' test.

shots.name: 08_gaia_end
shots.intent: The Gaia abutment. Checks the far end is dressed, not just the middle.

shots.name: 09_water_close
shots.intent: The Douro surface. Wave normals, glint, and the shore transition.

shots.name: 10_skyline_high
shots.intent: High wide. Tests the three-layer depth read and the sky.

shots.name: 11_fight_open
shots.intent: The opening frame of a real fight: hero, giant, camera framing, HUD, all live.

shots.name: 12_fight_close
shots.intent: Mid-combat. Hero at the giant, mid-swing — the game's core loop in one frame.

shots.name: 13_menu
shots.intent: The title screen, after the cinematic camera has settled.

shots.name: 14_hud
shots.intent: The HUD reading a live fight. UI legibility over a bright 3D scene.

shots.name: 15_hit_taken
shots.intent: A hero mid-damage. THE SHOT SET HAD NO DAMAGED FRAME, and that is how a full-screen crimson wash survived four rounds of review: HitVignette only draws once someone has been hit, and every game shot captured either the opening frame or a clean swing. A state nothing renders is a state nobody scores.
